__comment__: REALISTIC ROSIN: Fresh pine resin is 60-70% diterpene resin acids (abietic acid) dissolved in 20-30% volatile turpentine (alpha-pinene) plus 5-10% water. Distill at 150-200C: turpentine boils off (bp 154-170C), water evaporates, solid rosin remains. Rosin is brittle, glassy, yellow-amber – the classic tackifier that makes rubber actually sticky instead of just elastic. Since ~2000 BCE.
